name: gamedev-studio
description: GameDev AGI Studio plugin: binding owner decisions, quality rules and agent roles for building games with Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Binding studio rules for building games with coding agents
interface.longDescription: GameDev Studio tells agents to fetch the owner's binding decisions from GitHub Issues with gh and to apply them while they build games or extend this plugin. It adds engine profiles, skills for portal releases, art acceptance, assets and licences, localisation, audio, game feel, fair bots, monetization and orchestration, and the studio roles with on-demand reviewers.
defaultPrompt: Load the studio rules before starting work on this game.
